dimensions.assessment: Affects federal building tenants, facility security committee members, and federal workers in GSA-owned or operated buildings.
dimensions.evidence: guidance for building facility security committees to execute in any case in which life safety events threaten Federal buildings

dimensions.assessment: Establishes administrative guidance, standard operating procedures, and safety instructions rather than direct operational changes.
dimensions.evidence: develop and disseminate emergency communication guidance

dimensions.assessment: The source does not mention any federal spending or fiscal appropriations.
Directs two federal agencies to create specific communication guidance and submit a congressional report.
dimensions.evidence: Administrator of General Services and the Director of the Federal Protective Service shall develop and disseminate emergency communication guidance

dimensions.assessment: Requires guidance creation within one year and a report within 18 months, with ongoing implementation by security officials.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act... develop and disseminate

missing_information: Cost or implementation expenses associated with developing and executing the guidance.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires GSA and the Federal Protective Service to develop and disseminate emergency communication guidance and best practices for federal building security committees during life safety events.
